item.content:
Phase 1 exam engine enhancements completed for NEET Mitos:
- Created DPP attempt screen with countdown timer and review sheet
- Updated DPP screen to use DppConfig.single() instead of CBT mock config
- Enhanced CBT result screen with per-question review and color-coded status
- Added seed tracking to QuizAttempt model for deterministic shuffle reproducibility
- Updated CBT test screen to generate and persist random seed per attempt
- Added /dpp/attempt route to app router
- Regenerated drift database with build_runner (schema v25: DppSets.durationMinutes, QuizAttempts.seed)
- All 147 tests pass, debug APK builds successfully (31s)
- Remaining: DPP attempt timer auto-submit, question palette/mark-for-review in quiz mode, multi-subject DPP
item.context: Phase 1 implementation progress for NEET Mitos exam/DPP/quiz engine
